patch.value:
## Summary

The exact-head CodeRabbit completion predicate uses a separate raw substring denylist instead of the actionable-aware notice classification used elsewhere. As a result, it accepts some unavailable-review notices as completed reviews and rejects substantive reviews that discuss rate-limit handling.

Reproduced at **58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50**, package/manifest version **2026.10.12** (README still explicitly unreleased), with Node **v24.19.0** on Linux x86_64. The source-dispatch integration also used the retained official **@unbrained/pm-cli 2026.10.13**, matching this source's exact devDependency and minimum host. This is source acceptance, not a published npm/Bun artifact or deployed-host claim.

## Expected and actual

Both cases below are submitted `COMMENTED` reviews by `coderabbitai[bot]` on the exact current head, with successful checks, no unresolved threads, the required author vote, and retained imported context.

| Review body | Package notice classifier | Expected completion evidence | Actual completion evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Quota exhausted` | `isReviewNotice=true` | false | true |
| `**High**\nAdd retry backoff for rate-limit responses before writes.` | `isReviewNotice=false`; actionable import | true | false |

The second case has a recorded final fix and fixing SHA. All status blocker lists are empty; only the completion predicate keeps the gate false.

The complete 12-case independent oracle also finds false positives for `No access to this repository`, `Action not completed`, `Failed to generate review`, and `This repository does not receive automatic reviews.` Controls `Review failed`, `Rate-limit exceeded`, `Review skipped`, and `Trial ended` remain incomplete, while an empty submitted review and `No actionable issues.` remain eligible.

## Minimal offline reproduction

In a checkout of the exact commit, save this as `repro.mjs` and run `node repro.mjs`. It uses source modules only, requires no provider credentials, and performs no network or tracker writes.

```js
import { evaluateRound } from './src/round.ts';
import { findingsOf, isReviewNotice } from './src/findings.ts';
const head = 'a'.repeat(40);
for (const body of ['Quota exhausted', '**High**\nAdd retry backoff for rate-limit responses before writes.']) {
  const pr = {
    repo: 'example/package', number: 1, head, headDate: '2026-10-16T07:00:00Z', author: 'author',
    threads: [], comments: [], commits: [], checks: [{ name: 'CI', state: 'pass' }],
    reviews: [{ id: 'review-1', bot: 'coderabbitai[bot]', isBot: true, body,
      url: 'https://github.com/example/package/pull/1#pullrequestreview-1',
      createdAt: '2026-10-16T08:00:00Z', head, state: 'COMMENTED',
      reactions: [{ content: 'THUMBS_UP', user: 'author' }] }],
  };
  const items = findingsOf(pr).map(f => ({
    id: 'tracked-review', type: 'ReviewFinding', status: 'closed',
    review_repo: pr.repo, review_pr: pr.number, review_node_id: f.id,
    review_verdict: f.verdict === 'informational' ? 'informational' : 'fix',
  }));
  const result = evaluateRound(pr, items);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ body, notice: isReviewNotice(body),
    coderabbit_finished: result.coderabbit_finished, complete: result.complete }));
}
```

Observed:

```json
{"body":"Quota exhausted","notice":true,"coderabbit_finished":true,"complete":true}
{"body":"**High**\nAdd retry backoff for rate-limit responses before writes.","notice":false,"coderabbit_finished":false,"complete":false}
```

## Integration and preservation evidence

An independent real-filesystem SDK fixture imported the quota review as `informational` and `closed`. The unmodified `runReviewCommand` dispatcher, exercised through `activateExtensionForTest` / `runRegisteredCommandForTest` with only the transport boundary injected, returned for `review status`:

```json
{"handled":true,"result":{"complete":true,"unvoted_bot_items":[],"findings_without_verdict":[],"verdicts_without_reply":[],"stale_replies":[],"unresolved_threads":[],"current_head_review_completed":true},"warnings":[]}
```

After changing the same source to the substantive review body, import correctly reopened it as pending. A recorded fix with SHA then left all blocker lists empty, but status returned `complete=false`, `current_head_review_completed=false`, and host `exitCode=1`. Transport calls were synthetic; no GitHub reads/writes or paid calls were made by this execution.

All **77** focused authored tests from `core.test.ts`, `github.test.ts`, `review-regressions.test.ts` and `respond.test.ts` passed without skips. Independent replay preserved imported identity, local verdict/reason/commit and the single audit comment; reconcile dry-run and failed-read controls made no durable changes; applied reconciliation retained prior history bytes; retry added no closure history; 21 repeated read-only query probes left durable tracker/schema/history bytes unchanged. All six fixture history streams pass verification and both structural validations return ok=true; the active notice fixture reports missing acceptance-criteria/estimate metadata warnings, while the main fixture is warning-free. These controls do not eliminate the uncovered completion mismatch above.

## Cause and owner lineage

- [Completion predicate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50/src/round.ts#L17-L20) only rejects `review failed|rate[- ]limit|review skipped|trial (?:has )?ended` anywhere in the review body
- [Existing actionable-aware notice predicate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50/src/findings.ts#L15-L18) recognizes the broader notice family and retains substantive findings
- [Canonical round owner](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50/.agents/pm/features/pm-review-round.toon), delivered by #1
- [Related provider-notice classification item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50/.agents/pm/issues/pm-review-pr7r.toon), delivered by #1
- [Status integration owner](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50/.agents/pm/features/pm-review-respond.toon), delivered by #12

This is distinct from the already-open [round success exit-code contract](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/58ea2c294137f4e392931dad8bb0af4d054bbc50/.agents/pm/issues/pm-review-round-exit-contract.toon), also reproduced during this review: the successful round source result emits explicit zero, rejected by host normalization. Status omits explicit zero, so the false-green status above survives real host normalization. No duplicate exit-contract issue is requested.

All-status issues/PRs and relevant #1/#8/#9/#12 discussions were checked for this classification mismatch before filing. No equivalent open or closed finding was found.

## Acceptance criteria

1. All explicitly unavailable/incomplete notice bodies above fail completed-review evidence through both round and status, even when submitted for the exact head and every other condition is satisfied
2. A substantive severity-marked review about rate-limit handling remains eligible after its findings have been decided; quoted notice words cannot incorrectly erase substantive review evidence
3. Cover both cases through the source evaluator and actual registered-host dispatch with real temporary trackers, not only raw handler return assertions
4. Preserve exact-head, review state/author, complete pagination, live thread/vote, import completeness, durable verdict/history and no-write-on-failure contracts; empty submitted review and genuine no-actionable-review controls remain supported
5. Keep source and shipped-artifact validation separate; run packed consumers when the authorized toolchain is available

No implementation, source pin, original tracker, remote review state, merge or release was changed by this review.
